requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-2842-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-2842-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

222-527-3499-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3499-4247.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

851-2557-3129-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
997-6972-7932.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4636-5770-7824.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5982-6968.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5982-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2919-5070-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-5070-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

620-3532-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
620-3532-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

4771-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

997-4381--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2445-3099-4762-7267.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Michelangelo and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

339-413-677-4742.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2366-4927-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4927-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

465-2292-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1734-2150-2511.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

1978-3263-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat

2034-4908-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3446-5078-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2178-4681-6542-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
2178-4681-6542-6798.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1168-1651-1770-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-1770-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-1770-5967-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1445-2366-4826-6413-6753.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2366-4826-6413-6753.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2351-3499-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-3499-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

957-4543-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {4} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each other turn
957-4543-6333-6678.description:
Cast Time Stretch from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your first extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat during your second extra turn

224-1772-2653-3756.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

3263-4853-4888-5231.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {1}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Repeat.

3525-4659-4871-4917.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Jan Jansen.
3525-4659-4871-4917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
3525-4659-4871-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Construct tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Constructs die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

645-1267-5256-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5256-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

224-423-1315-2309-3143.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Fall of the Thran has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
224-423-1315-2309-3143.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fall of the Thran triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Fall of the Thran's second or third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land, causing you to gain 2 life.
You may optionally repeat step 3 one additional time.
If Fall of the Thran has three loyalty counters on it, activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a lore counter from Fall of the Thran, causing you to populate.
Resolve the Fall of the Thran chapter trigger from step 2, causing each player to return two land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Whenever the land(s) enter the battlefield, Evolution Sage and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger for each land that entered the battlefield under your control.
Holding priority, if the land(s) enter the battlefield untapped, you may activate them by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, if applicable, either causing you to scry 1 or to tap or untap target creature.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 2.
If applicable, resolve all remaining Evolution Sage triggers, causing you to proliferate that many times.
If you sacrifice and return two lands each cycle, this combo will net infinite untap of creatures you control and infinite scry 1.

275-1799-3621-5147.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
275-1799-3621-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

127-565-974.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
127-565-974.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Imps' Taunt with buyback by paying {4}{B}, targeting the Smaug token.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put the new Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve Imps' Taunt from step 2, returning it to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature(s) you control using Imps' Taunt, to create infinite tokens of them using Orvar.

1858-4280-5195.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve View from Above, giving Storm-Kiln Artist flying until end of turn and returning View from Above to your hand.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

38-2506-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
The Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Lightning Crafter.
Resolve the Lightning Crafter trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Lightning Crafter token, adding {R}.
The Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken LIghtning Crafter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1331-2339-4625.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to inferno Titan.
Inferno Titan does not have summoning sickness.
1331-2339-4625.description:
Attack with Inferno Titan, triggering Inferno Titan and dealing 2 damage divided among targets of your choice and 1 damage to itself, destroying Inferno Titan.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Inferno Titan to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Inferno Titan triggers, dealing 2 damage divided among targets of your choice and 1 damage to itself, destroying Inferno Titan.
Repeat.

1987-2493-3075-3448.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-2493-3075-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.

862-3249-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {R}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
